core_problem_solved: To provide a Java-optimized API for building and manipulating XML documents in memory, designed as an easier-to-use alternative to the standard W3C DOM.
key_features: A concrete, class-based object model for XML, using Java Collections.
A focus on ease of use and simplicity for Java developers.
era_and_niche: The original, legacy Maven coordinate for the pioneering JDOM XML API, popular in the early 2000s.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact and coordinate are **obsolete**. The project moved to the `org.jdom` groupId and released a completely rewritten successor, **`org.jdom:jdom2`**. The entire JDOM family is also considered a legacy choice for new projects compared to JAXB or Jackson-XML for data binding.
